caption: The drawing shows a single cylindrical jar with a slightly flared rim and a narrow opening at the top. The jar is shaded in a brownish-tan color, with subtle variations to suggest roundness and shadow. Near the shoulder of the jar, there are two blue decorative leaf-like patterns, one on each side, oriented horizontally and curving slightly upward. The background of the image is a plain off-white or cream color, with faint rectangular border lines around the edges. There are small spots of discoloration or wear at the corners of the paper. In the lower right corner, there is a small sketch of the jar’s outline with a scale indicator marked “SCALE 1/8 = 1 INCH.”
title: Crock
